cands.name: Audrey Gibson
cands.bio: Democrat running unopposed for House District 13. Former state senator (District 6, Jacksonville, 2016-2022; earlier Senate Districts 9 and 1) and former state representative (House District 15, 2002-2010).
cands.local_ties: Downtown Jacksonville, Duval County (area she has represented; FL DOE filing address is in Duval County).

record.text: Florida Senate 2011-2022 (Districts 1, 9, then 6) and Florida House District 15 from 2002 to 2010, per Wikipedia. Current HD 13 incumbent Angie Nixon is leaving the seat to run for U.S. Senate (per Wikipedia 2026 House page).
